typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		NETTED_TRANSFER as integer,
		INTERNAL_LE_LONGNAME as string,
		EVENT_TYPE as string,
		INTERNAL_LEID as integer,
		IS_PAYMENT as integer,
		EXTERNAL_LEID as integer,
		EXT_SDI_STATUS as string,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		EXTERNAL_SDIID as integer,
		TRANSFER_AMOUNT as double,
		BOOK_ID as integer,
		EXTERNAL_LE_SHORTNAME as string,
		SETTLE_DATE as timestamp,
		INTERNAL_SDI_INSTR as string,
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		EXTERNAL_SDI_ROLE as string,
		INTERNAL_SDI_ROLE as string,
		SETTLECURRENCY as string,
		EXTERNAL_SDI_INSTR as string,
		PAYRECEIVE_TYPE as string,
		VALUE_DATE as timestamp,
		EXTERNAL_SDI_INSTRSTATUS as string,
		INTERNAL_LE_SHORTNAME as string,
		INTERNAL_SDI_INSTRSTATUS as string,
		PO_SETTLE_METHOD as string,
		IS_KNOWN as integer,
		SETTLE_AMOUNT as double,
		EXTERNAL_LE_LONGNAME as string,
		TRANSFER_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_TYPE as string,
		INTERNAL_SDIID as integer,
		INT_SDI_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		NETTED_TRANSFER as integer,
		INTERNAL_LE_LONGNAME as string,
		EVENT_TYPE as string,
		INTERNAL_LEID as integer,
		IS_PAYMENT as integer,
		EXTERNAL_LEID as integer,
		EXT_SDI_STATUS as string,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		EXTERNAL_SDIID as integer,
		TRANSFER_AMOUNT as double,
		BOOK_ID as integer,
		EXTERNAL_LE_SHORTNAME as string,
		SETTLE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		INTERNAL_SDI_INSTR as string,
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		EXTERNAL_SDI_ROLE as string,
		INTERNAL_SDI_ROLE as string,
		SETTLECURRENCY as string,
		EXTERNAL_SDI_INSTR as string,
		PAYRECEIVE_TYPE as string,
		VALUE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EXTERNAL_SDI_INSTRSTATUS as string,
		INTERNAL_LE_SHORTNAME as string,
		INTERNAL_SDI_INSTRSTATUS as string,
		PO_SETTLE_METHOD as string,
		IS_KNOWN as integer,
		SETTLE_AMOUNT as double,
		EXTERNAL_LE_LONGNAME as string,
		TRANSFER_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_TYPE as string,
		INTERNAL_SDIID as integer,
		INT_SDI_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		NETTED_TRANSFER,
		INTERNAL_LE_LONGNAME,
		EVENT_TYPE,
		INTERNAL_LEID,
		IS_PAYMENT,
		EXTERNAL_LEID,
		EXT_SDI_STATUS,
		TRANSFER_STATUS,
		EXTERNAL_SDIID,
		TRANSFER_AMOUNT,
		BOOK_ID,
		EXTERNAL_LE_SHORTNAME,
		SETTLE_DATE,
		INTERNAL_SDI_INSTR,
		TRADE_ID,
		EXTERNAL_SDI_ROLE,
		INTERNAL_SDI_ROLE,
		SETTLECURRENCY,
		EXTERNAL_SDI_INSTR,
		PAYRECEIVE_TYPE,
		VALUE_DATE,
		EXTERNAL_SDI_INSTRSTATUS,
		INTERNAL_LE_SHORTNAME,
		INTERNAL_SDI_INSTRSTATUS,
		PO_SETTLE_METHOD,
		IS_KNOWN,
		SETTLE_AMOUNT,
		EXTERNAL_LE_LONGNAME,
		TRANSFER_ID,
		TRANSFER_TYPE,
		INTERNAL_SDIID,
		INT_SDI_STATUS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
